definition: Income from activities classified as the business operations.
formula: Sum transaction charges, listing fees, clearing-fund treasury income and other operating services.
history: Q4FY26 1,563.51; Q1FY26 957.95; FY25 2,957.34; FY26 4,833.95. Earlier full series unresolved.
peers: MCX FY26 INR2,302cr, P1 PDF13; NSE consolidated figure missing.
interpretation: Fast YoY growth but near-flat latest quarter; investigate product drivers.
limitations: Operating classification includes some treasury income; not synonymous with pure fees.

definition: Operating revenue plus investment and other income.
formula: Operating revenue + investment income + other income.
peers: FY26 NSE18,713 rounded; MCX2,429.05cr; P2/P1.
interpretation: Captures overall income scale; not all growth reflects customer demand.
limitations: Investment returns and classifications can distort comparisons.

definition: Growth measures change; CAGR is the smooth annual rate linking endpoints.
formula: Period growth = current/prior −1; CAGR = (end/start)^(1/number of years) −1.
history: FY21–FY26 total-income CAGR51.1%, five intervals; S3.
peers: FY26 operating growth BSE63.5%, MCX106.9%; NSE missing.
interpretation: Small starting bases and new products can produce large growth.
limitations: CAGR hides volatility; unlike annual revenue, quarters have seasonality.
assessment: Improving annual scale; latest quarter stable

definition: Operating earnings before interest, tax and depreciation, after regulatory and SGF expense here.
formula: Pre-associate PBT − investment/other income + depreciation + finance cost.
history: FY25 approximately1,499.72cr; longer harmonised series unavailable.
peers: MCX FY26 1,646.58cr after excluding other income; P1.
interpretation: Shows core earning capacity before depreciation and tax.
limitations: Not cash flow; excludes the cost of replacing assets through depreciation.

definition: Operating EBITDA retained per rupee of operating revenue.
formula: Operating EBITDA / operating revenue.
history: FY25 50.7%; older aligned series incomplete.
peers: MCX FY26 71.5%, FY25 59.8%; NSE missing.
interpretation: For INR100 operating revenue, FY26 retains aboutINR63.7 before depreciation/tax.
limitations: Do not compare directly with MCX73% total-income headline margin.

definition: Operating earnings after depreciation, before financing and tax.
formula: Operating EBITDA − depreciation.
history: FY25 approximately1,386.74cr. Longer aligned series unresolved.
peers: MCX FY26 INR1,568.54cr on aligned basis; P1.
interpretation: Recognises consumption of technology and infrastructure assets.
limitations: Useful lives and capitalisation policies affect depreciation.

definition: Returns booked on invested assets, separate from operating revenue in this model.
formula: Use financial statement line; separate realised gains, valuation changes and interest where available.
history: Q4FY26 61.69; Q1FY26 79.06; FY26 290.30cr. Five-year composition missing.
peers: Peer detailed investment composition not reconciled.
interpretation: Explains much of sequential income growth.
limitations: Income may be non-cash or rate-sensitive; not all balances belong freely to owners.

definition: Accounting tax expense relative to profit before tax.
formula: Total tax / reported PBT including associate contribution, for the historical ratio.
history: FY25 24.66%; longer series unresolved.
peers: Comparable peer taxes before/after associate profits not reconciled.
interpretation: Useful for checking forecast taxes and unusual tax effects.
limitations: Associate profits already bear tax; deferred/prior-period tax distorts the ratio. Scenarios tax pre-associate profit.

definition: Profit after tax allocated to BSE shareholders.
formula: Group PAT − profit attributable to non-controlling owners.
current_value: Q1FY27 INR874.02cr; group872.66 less minority loss−1.36; S2.
peers: Peer tables use group PAT separately; matching parent series incomplete.
interpretation: Correct earnings basis for shareholder EPS.
limitations: Exceptional/discontinued gains and minority losses affect comparability.

definition: Share of income retained as after-tax group profit.
formula: Total-operation GROUP PAT / total income, consistently for comparison.
history: FY25 40.9%; long adjusted chart is not a uniform reported series.
peers: NSE FY26 55.1%; MCX54.8% using arithmetic definition, P2/P1.
interpretation: Shows conversion of all income to group profit, not purely operating efficiency.
limitations: Mixes non-operating and exceptional effects; differs from issuer-defined margins.

definition: Profit attributable to each share after the relevant share-count convention.
formula: Parent PAT / weighted-average eligible shares; basic and diluted published together here.
history: FY26 60.61; FY25 32.18; Q4FY26 19.35. Historical adjusted chart not merged.
peers: MCX FY26 INR52.22 after its share-unit adjustment; raw EPS level is not a value ranking.
interpretation: Per-share earnings matter more than total profit when dilution changes.
limitations: Abeyance, bonuses, splits and adjusted versus total-operation definitions must match.

definition: Trailing EPS covers the latest four quarters; P/E is price per rupee of that earnings.
formula: TTM EPS = FY26 − Q1FY26 + Q1FY27; P/E = quote / TTM EPS.
history: FY26-basis55.7x; annualised latest-quarter39.8x is a sensitivity. Historical range unavailable.
peers: Matched-date NSE/MCX valuation unavailable; percentile not calculated.
interpretation: A high multiple requires durable growth or other advantages to justify it.
limitations: Official quote unverified; trailing profit is not a forward forecast.

definition: Profit earned relative to shareholders capital.
formula: Annual parent PAT / average opening and closing parent equity.
history: Prior year average-equity series not reconciled; no five-year trend claimed.
peers: Aligned peer average-equity data unavailable.
interpretation: High observed profitability relative to accounting capital.
limitations: Distributions, small equity and exceptional gains can boost ROE. Ending-equity ROE differs.
assessment: Insufficient trend evidence; strong current observation

definition: Profit relative to all recorded assets.
formula: Annual group PAT / average opening and closing group assets.
history: Earlier aligned series not built.
peers: Peer clearing-asset conventions unresolved.
interpretation: Provides a broad capital-intensity diagnostic.
limitations: Clearing collateral and earmarked funds make industrial-bank comparisons misleading.

definition: Return on capital employed in operations.
formula: ROIC = normalised after-tax operating profit / average operating invested capital; ROCE = EBIT / average defined capital employed.
current_value: — UNRESOLVED: operating capital cannot yet be isolated reliably.
history: — Five-year harmonised series unavailable.
peers: — No peer median or rank.
interpretation: Would help test returns on technology and retained capital.
limitations: Restricted cash, float, regulatory capital and associates need explicit treatment.

definition: Cash generated by operating activity after working-capital changes and cash taxes.
formula: Reported continuing cash-flow statement under indirect method.
history: FY25 INR410.15cr; earlier series unresolved.
peers: Peer matched cash-flow basis unavailable.
interpretation: Cash generation improved; inspect liability contribution.
limitations: Settlement/earmarked balances and timing can obscure shareholder cash.

definition: How much accounting profit is accompanied by operating cash.
formula: Continuing group CFO / continuing group PAT; multi-year uses sums, not average ratios.
history: FY25 0.31x; combined two-year0.93x. No five-year series.
peers: Peer clearing/continuing basis incomplete.
interpretation: A two-year view moderates the strong latest-year reading.
limitations: Different cash-tax timing, associate income and liability flows affect the ratio.

definition: Cash invested in infrastructure; residual after those purchases.
formula: CFO − cash purchases of PPE/intangibles/CWIP/capital advances, no assumed maintenance split.
current_value: FY26 capexINR515.16cr; CFO less capexINR2,588.52cr; S1.
history: FY25 153.23 and256.92cr respectively. Long history incomplete.
peers: Peer cash-capex definitions not reconciled.
interpretation: Shows investment demands alongside cash generation.
limitations: Not distributable cash; ignores extra regulatory/clearing capital and acquisitions.

definition: Simplified number of revenue-days tied up in receivables.
formula: Ending net trade receivables / annual operating revenue ×365.
history: FY25 35.5days; earlier series unavailable.
peers: Peer receivable/revenue mix not matched.
interpretation: Collection absorption rose relative to revenue; investigate ageing.
limitations: Ending balances, non-credit revenue and mix distort exact collection duration.
assessment: Deteriorating diagnostic, not proof of credit loss

definition: Balances held for company use versus designated obligations.
formula: Classify by legal entity, restriction and linked liability before estimating excess cash.
current_value: Owned-bank subtotalINR3,001.11cr excluding accrued interest; original model S1 notes11–12.
history: No consistent three-to-five-year usable-cash series.
peers: Peer required-capital treatment unresolved.
interpretation: A large cash balance does not imply an equal special dividend.
limitations: Owned is not necessarily excess; reserve and operating needs remain.

definition: Disclosed possible obligations, not necessarily probable losses.
formula: Sum separately disclosed claim and guarantee amounts; do not add provisions again.
current_value: FY26 aggregateINR330.16cr; S1 note37, original model.
history: FY25 corresponding aggregateINR239.08cr; note37.
peers: Peer legal exposures not standardised.
interpretation: Larger disclosed exposure warrants scrutiny of cases and collateral.
limitations: No loss probability or timing is established by the aggregate.

definition: Average daily option premium traded; fee earned per unit of chargeable activity.
formula: ADTV = premium turnover / trading days; yield = relevant revenue / correctly scoped chargeable turnover.
current_value: Q1FY27 premium ADTVINR29,615.4cr/day, S3 PDF13. Net yield not computed.
history: Q4FY26 INR28,920.7cr/day; longer like-for-like share/yield series pending.
peers: NSE Q4FY26 INR76,375cr/day per P2; do not mix Q4 with BSE Q1.
interpretation: More relevant than notional turnover for options fee analysis.
limitations: Trading days, one/two-sided charging, mix and discounts need reconciliation.

definition: Cash distributed to owners and conditional wealth changes.
formula: Dividend yield = comparable DPS/price; model wealth = terminal EPS×P/E + cumulative unreinvested DPS.
current_value: Historical yield not asserted; scenario payout capped at25%profit and cash proxy.

peers: Peer dividend policies and record dates not aligned.
interpretation: Dividends supplement price return but depend on available cash.
